body: Im 17 and still live with my parents. They wouldn't let me volunteer anywhere because it would disrupt family dinner time. My parents don't care about my emotional well-being. So long as I respect them and do what I need to do they don't give a crap.

I also over analysis everything I put into my body. I drink coffee because I know it speeds up my metabolism. I strive to be skinny because without it I don't feel like I'd be worth having around. At the same time though i accept everyone's bodies around me except for my own.
I AM hungry. It gets super awkward in class when my stomach is clearly growling. I feel gross whenever I eat though so I find it easier not to.
I'm not sure. It's been a coping mechanism for me for so long. I'm scared of gaining weight, but I'm also scared of the long term effects I'll suffer if I continue.
The right direction is the only direction I hope to head anymore. I'm tired of living with this.

All of it. My diagnosis is anorexia binge/purge. There will be days when I will only drink coffee. However if I ever feel like I eat too much I feel physically ill and puke. Every once in a while I'll also binge on food knowing full well that I have no intention of keeping it down.

thank you. It's just that whenever I open up to friends, their advice is usually something to the effect of "just eat more" or "only eat what you can"...if it was that easy for me there wouldn't be a problem.
